correctness.rationale: An invertible affine normalization puts the tetrahedron into x_i>=0, sum x_i<=1 with x1<=1-s,x2<=1-t. For nonoverlapping caps their total volume is (1-s^3-t^3)/6; the three coordinate facets contribute explicitly via the mixed-area formula, giving N/6 with N=(1-s)(1-t^2)+(1-t)(1-s^2)+1-s^2-t^2. The exact factorization of rho-5/3 and strict derivative of N in u=s+t at fixed c=s^3+t^3 prove the plateau, complete sharp fixed-volume extrema and their equality cases. Eleven independent exact rational difference-body convex-hull volumes check mixed-volume polarization and 66 additional rational instances test the algebra. Finite checks are not an infinite-dimensional proof; the written analytic argument proves every admissible real parameter.
